title: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming, structured output & function-calls
author: Maya Kline
description: Adds parity coverage for OpenAI /v1/chat.completions semantics: broad parameter mapping (temperature, top_p, n, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty), full support for message roles including assistant/system/user, stop token handling, and legacy logprobs/echo behavior. Also stabilizes streaming protocol when function/tool calls are in-flight, introduces structured output alignment for JSON-schema/function call responses, and updates the OpenAI compatibility layer to fall back to modeled variants when exact features are unsupported. Motivation: several customers (internal and early beta) expect byte-for-byte compatibility with OpenAI chat endpoints; mismatches around stop/logprobs and streaming+function-calls caused UI regressions and eval drift. This PR implements the compatibility surface, adds e2e tests, and documents differences and opt-in flags.
